steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: *glug* *glug*—

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Hah, how intoxicating the aroma of fine wine is.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Open up, Erato.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Erato—you won't get anywhere even if you shut yourself inside. I suggest you give up.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Everyone and their mother can hear you, you binge-drinking priestess.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: I'm merely worried about you, Erato.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Last night, while I was enjoying my wine, by chance I overheard the conversation of a few operators. I heard you've locked yourself in your room for two full days and nights now.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: As a priestess, naturally I am concerned. Look, the morning sunlight has only just reached your windowsill, and I am already come to visit.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Visit? ...What's that you're holding?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Fine wine.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: O Mountains of Minos, would you grant me your blessings, and keep those with poor taste in alcohol far away?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Seeing how you still have the strength for sarcasm, I take it your new poem is coming along nicely?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: ...How did you know I'm working on a new poem?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: You've been idling about ever since your arrival in Rhodes Island... What are you planning to write?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: A long epic. One about a number of heroes with a variety of talents and personalities, who together lead the oppressed in their quest to triumph over their hardships and reach a land of hope... or something like that.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Sadly... writer's block.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Beset by a blank page then?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: That's not true! I... I finished the title!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I had three heroes in mind so far: an adept warrior, a genius smith, and a gracious healer...

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Maybe because it's been a while since I wrote, but I can't quite grasp the characters, and the story I had in mind is also lacking in realism. I'm finding it hard to establish their characters too... I need more inspiration.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Perhaps we can let the wine flow while we discuss these heroic legends, just like we do back home?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: And loosened by wine, surely you'll be plucking inspiration like apples from the tree of wisdom.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Please don't make up excuses to drink that wine you brought.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Maybe leaf through some literature then, or take a stroll outside? No doubt you know the ways of the Minoan poets better than I.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Of course. Can't you see I was getting ready to leave in search of heroics?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Speaking of heroics, aside from our homeland, Victoria and Kazimierz should both be wonderful places for inspiration too. Among your many choices.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I won't be going anywhere that far. I already have a place in mind.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Let's chat another time. I need to hurry.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: What else do you want?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: I've always been very interested in how you write your poems.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Given how rarely such an opportunity presents itself, surely you wouldn't refuse if I proposed to join you on your journey?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Fine, follow me.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: This is my first stop.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: What a surprise. So you never even planned to leave Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Of course not. There's more than enough inspiration on board.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: And when it comes to finding masterful warriors, where better than the training room?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: But did we come too early? There doesn't seem to be anyone here...
Hah! How about that?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Someone's speaking.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Yes, I also have ears— Hello?
Take this!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Oh, it's Flint.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: You're Pallas. And... you're...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: You're not very tall, and you don't come to the training grounds often. I don't remember you.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I'm Erato. I spend most of my time on field operations. We've only met a few times.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Oh, hello.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Right, Erato. Wanna fight?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Huh?! What's with this all of a sudden?!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: If you don't want to, then never mind.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Sorry. I'm not very good at melee combat, but maybe I can challenge you at archery.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: It's fine.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: (Turns back to the sandbag)

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Ha!

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: We'd best wait a little longer. Considering the time, there will be more operators here soon enough.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Erato?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I've heard about how strong Flint is, but this is the first time I've seen her fighting form in person.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: That valiant posture, those fierce blows... This is exactly what I am looking for...

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Flint, no, O Warrior Adept! I wish to learn of extraordinary deeds, and surely a hero such as you has many to her name. Might you indulge me in one or two?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hero? I don't really get anything else you just said, but I've never even seen a hero.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: And these 'deeds' you're talking about... what're they even good for?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I'm looking for heroic deeds as inspiration, to help me write my next epic!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Oh, I see. You want inspiration.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Come here, then.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Come. Stand here.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: This is a sandbag. Pound it.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Uh... Like this?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: That was too weak. Stronger.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Like this?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Still too weak. Try punching it harder.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Hah! Ow... that hurt...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Yes, just like that! Did you feel anything?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Pain...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: And?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Just pain...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: No way. You didn't feel inspired?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Not at all.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Weird. Whenever I'm sparring I get super inspired, like I'll suddenly think of a feint I can work into a low jab.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Any kind of problem should be solved with your fists. Maybe you just need more practice fighting.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Come on, try it out a few more times.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Wait, let's stop here...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Flint? Flint, are you there?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I'm here.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ah, Erato and Pallas are here too.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Flint, take a good look at this list of compensation expenses incurred from your last field mission. Logistics racked up a huge bill settling the problems you left behind.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: And this one line from your mission report: 'I knocked that tall guy down because he was looking down at me so fiercely.'

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: You didn't just 'knock him down,' you beat him up so badly he was rolling around in pain and even managed to smash through two doors!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: No way, I was holding back. Come on, I only hit him twice...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Anyway, I'm just advising you to be extra careful not damage public property while on missions, because if this happens again—

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: The sandbag......

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Exploded with one punch...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ah, forget it. Flint, this is for you.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: A thank you letter from the girl you saved on that last mission.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Oh, okay.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: (Stuffs the letter into her glove)

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I'll go get a new sandbag.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: It seems I've made the right choice, Erato.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Accompanying you on your journey has been far more gratifying than pouring myself another drink on the bridge.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Are all you priestesses like this, or are you just this boring, Miss 'Goddess of Victory'?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: I'm sure you know just how uniquely unparalleled I am.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: We've arrived our next destination.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: There's no shortage of brilliant engineers on Rhodes Island, so surely we'll be able to find a—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey! Erato and Pallas? Giorno to the both of ya!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Hello, Chiave. Are you the only one in here?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta was just here though? Huh, where'd he go?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta? Where'd you go?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Wait, there's no need for that. I'll just talk to you.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: As I recall, you're... quite good at designing machines?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: 'Course I am. My modding skills are first-class, you could even call me a genius!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Wonderful. I'd like to ask you then, have you ever done anything you would consider heroic...?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Here, hold onto this for a sec.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: ...A hydraulic clamp?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You're asking me about modding, right? When I was still learning how to fix cars, my mentor once told me that it's nice hearing how great something is, but nothing beats experiencing it for yourself.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: No, I just wanted to ask you about your own heroic deeds...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Now hold on tight, I'll give you a demonstration.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Of what...?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Ahhh!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Why, why am I flying?!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: What do you think? My latest invention, a self-suspension hydraulic clamp!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I have to deal with a lot of heavy equipment here, and it's such a pain lugging my tools up and down the ladders every time!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But now, with this baby, you can float up with them! No more ladders!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: It can fly even higher, so don't let go!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I-Its vibrating quite a bit, is this normal?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Vibrating? ...Did I forget to install the motor rotor? Wait, did I even...

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: It's going wild, I can't hold on any longer!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Careful! It's flying towards you!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Wha—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Yow!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ow ow ow! Ugh, my head...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: A malfunction? How did that happen? Weird, was the jet engine too powerful? Eh, screw it, I can think about it later.

spans.text: happen? Weird, was the jet engine too powerful? Eh, screw it, I can think about it later.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You were asking me earlier if I've done any heroic deeds?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Well, I must proudly declare—

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Nope!

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: An unexpected answer.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Well, it's 'cause I give my all to my modded equipment.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: So they're the real heroes, the ones who've achieved plenty of unprecedented feats in my place! They're the ones everyone should remember!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: As for me, I invented them, so maybe you can call me... uh... a 'Hero Creator'?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Heh, I like the sound of that.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: 'Hero Creator'? Tsk.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Aosta! What's that 'tsk' supposed to mean, huh? You don't like it?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: What 'heroes' are you talking about? The drill that can sing, maybe the wrench that can dance?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Oh, now we have one more: a hydraulic clamp that can fly.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey! How can you disrespect your boss like this?!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: According to my statistics, the last time you received a modding request was... three months back?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, you sure about that? I've got the feeling I did a real good job somewhere! Definitely!

spans.text: Hey, you sure about that? I've got the feeling I did a real good job

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Just admit it, Chiave. You're hopeless.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Hey, this helmet on the table... I remember seeing it out on a field mission a while back.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: A defender operator was fuming: 'I only asked for my goggles to be fixed, but that guy added a whole bunch of extra functions!'

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: But during that same mission, the squad encountered an unexpected source of Originium pollution.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: They lacked proper Originium detection equipment, but the detector on the helmet managed to work and helped them avert a crisis.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ya hear that, Aosta? I'm out there saving the day!

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Then why did they send the helmet back?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Oh, as I recall, it started leaking electricity later in the mission...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Anyway, I'll never give up on my creations, and my genius must stay unburied.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: For there will come a day when I myself will be worthy of being called a hero, and not just a 'Hero Creator' or whatever. Just you wait, Aosta!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Oh, I forgot you girls were still here. Sorry, Erato. I didn't have any of those heroic tales you wanted.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: It's fine.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: But I was thinking, if you wanted to ask someone else, I have someone in mind.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: And who might that be?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: My dear friend, Lancet-2!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: She's been down in the dumps lately, even though she's been working so hard.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: And while she's always been the negative sort... maybe she'd cheer up if you let her know all the heroic deeds she's done!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Alright, got it.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Come back and hang out if you have time, and let me know whenever if you need anything modded!

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Erato, are you seriously considering Chiave's suggestion?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Of course. As it happens, my original plan also included paying a visit to the medics on board.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Do you think this 'quest' of yours, if you'll permit me such a word, will ultimately prove fruitful for your work?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I couldn't say.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I've previously amassed a collection of legends and stories, and for the sake of preserving them properly, I will do my best to act as an earnest recorder.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: The key is to not let any subjective emotions and thoughts pollute the record, so that the stories maintain their original form.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Once this journey has concluded, everything I've seen, witnessed, heard, and recorded will gradually settle down within a few nights.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Then, it flows into poetry under my pen, and through my voice presents itself to the audience.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: The 'quest' is not yet over, though, so I can only speculate how it will end.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Recording, creating, eulogizing... you've given yourself far more duties to bear than a simple wandering bard.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I like to think of this as my passion.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Or perhaps it's your liberty.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: ...But I have a hunch that what I see and hear this time won't affect my creation all that much.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Before I was simply curious about your process, but now I've become quite interested in the poem you will write.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: What do I do... what do I do?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Hello, Lancet-2... what are you doing?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Hello. Based on the status displayed on my motion module, I am currently spinning in circles.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I can see that, but... why?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Doctor... because of the Doctor.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Did something happen to them?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: No, it's my fault.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Because I am incompetent, useless, and can't do anything right.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Hold on, could you elaborate? What happened exactly?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Pallas, so you're saying if I hit her twice like this, she'll be able to speak normally?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: You can try.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Checking language module—operation will resume when the process is complete.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: The reason is that the Doctor has been so busy recently. They have so much paperwork to deal with every day, and are unable to go to bed until early morning.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: If this goes on, there will certainly be abnormalities in the results of their next physical examination.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: It's because I'm so bad at taking good care of them. It's all my fault—

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Stop right there.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: The Doctor has their own duties too, Lancet-2. Their work is very important to all of us here, so it's normal to be busy every now and then.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: You've been working hard, so you shouldn't blame yourself for the current situation, alright?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Really? Operator Erato, do you really think so?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Of course, I came here today just to ask for your help. May I ask if you have any heroic deeds to share with me?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Heroic deeds... I have overheard the chatter of the operators I look after, and even have some events saved in my memory module.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: No, no, no, not those. I want to know your own stories, especially the heroic ones.

spans.text: No, no, no, not those. I want to know your

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: You do such brilliant work, so surely there would be many of them?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: My own heroic deeds... No, I don't think anything I've done could be called 'heroic,' and such a title doesn't suit me at all.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: In my line of work, you would only be a hero if you could take care of all the operators here and keep everyone healthy.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: But I haven't done such a deed; I can't even take good care of the Doctor... Perhaps I'm not even the least bit competent.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: She certainly is a negative one.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Alright, alright. How about this: could you take care of me for a bit?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Take care of you, Operator Erato? This is indeed with my scope of work, but... is there a reason why you want me to?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: So I can properly judge how good you are at it, and just maybe you'll also realize how useful you are in the process.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Understood. Please hold still for a moment, Operator Erato. I will conduct a full-body physical examination right away.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Examination—complete. The test results are as follows: Operator Erato has not slept for 27 hours, 13 minutes, and 27 seconds, and her body is in urgent need of rest.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: ...A few hours ago, you also ingested a large amount of sugar and fat.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Erato, I seem to recall you repeatedly declaring your intention to lose weight.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: ...It's all for the sake of the plan, the plan!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: How could this happen? How did I not notice this abnormality until now?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: I should have noticed the moment you stepped in, but I was so busy handling my emotional module that I neglected you... I truly am incompetent.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: No, that's not your fault at all.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: I can't do even a single thing right. I should just drive myself over to the scrap area.

options: So the both of you are here too.

steps.name: Erato & Pallas
steps.text: Hello, Doctor.

options: Lancet-2, I'm here for my examination.
You seem upset, something on your mind?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Doctor... I'm sorry, I haven't taken good care of you.

options: But thanks to you, my results come back normal.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Huh, is that so?
You run the examinations so quickly.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: The results are here, and the data indicates—

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Everything normal. Wonderful.

options: There's absolutely no need to worry.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: (The Doctor's coffee ration has been reduced, but they still consume it regularly.)

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: You're really great at your work, Lancet-2.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Oh, sorry, I was just thinking...

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Doctor, I have somewhere else to be, so I'll be going! Bye!
A week later

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Oh, so it wasn't just me who received an invitation.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: An invitation to a 'poetry recital'... I don't get it, what's a 'poetry'?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Poetry is a form of literature that narrates events or expresses emotions in condensed and rhythmic language, and listeners can often feel enlightened by such recitals.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: This is the first public recital of Erato's latest work, which is expected to have a positive impact on the mental health of the operators present.

options: Erato's new poem... Looking forward to it.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: *Ahem*

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: (I did invite everyone, but I didn't expect so many to attend...)

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Thank you for coming to the recital of my latest poem. I dearly hope everyone has a pleasant time.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Alright, now let's get right to it. The poem that I will now recite is titled...

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: (Ah, I'm so nervous. The last time I recited a new poem in front of such a crowd was many years ago in Corinia's town square...)

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Erato! Erato!

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Ahem, without further ado, I will recite my latest creation—

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: 'The Epic of Heroes.'

a.text: O distant sky up high,
Let us all sing under you,
The will of the masses.
In the far, far away of the lands beyond,
The mountains are but no more,
All that is left is a wasteland of gold sand and black gravel.
Civilization suffers under the whip,
Struggling like foam in wine,
Beasts unseen devour hearts still live.
On an unexpected summer night,
It happens.
Three heroes,
Rise from their kin who raised them,
And they swore to the sun,
To unshackle them,
And lead their peoples towards a land in full bloom.

steps.text: Accompanied by the sound of the harp strings and Erato's gentle recital, the stories of the three heroes were told.

a.text: They hailed from the masses,
Not mighty,
Nor flawless.
An adept warrior, weak with words and quick to anger.
A genius smith, reckless and full of arrogance.
A gracious healer, low on esteem and high on negativity.
However, when beset with crisis without end,
The warrior is unafraid to face foes over twice their size.
The smith with their miracle tool saves the people from danger.
The healer strives their utmost to help everyone in need.
They hailed from the masses,
Not mighty,
Nor flawless.
Leading them all onwards.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Dawn lifts her veil, and the sun spills its radiance on the land, brushing off her dust-covered visage.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: A fragrance wafts from afar, and the people pick up their belongings, persisting on their journey.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Thank you everyone, thank you.
The recital came to an end, and one by one the audience leaves reluctantly.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Well, Pallas. It's been three days since you've heard the poem, do you still have no thoughts on it?

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: If I heard you right, that was just the first part of it.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: I must admit, it holds much of your personal style, but I will refrain from any further comments until it is finished.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: It must be pretty decent to get the always-chatty Pallas to hold her tongue.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: Rather bickering with you any further, I'd like to know how you plan to finish the rest of the poem. The material you've amassed surely isn't enough for the entire work?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: Yes, I'm running empty on inspiration for now, so at the moment I'm just entertaining a concept in my head.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I want to create a character based on myself, and walk together with the heroes in the story, to the land of my dreams brimming with flowers.

steps.name: Pallas
steps.text: I understand. Every Minoan dreams of walking alongside the heroes, after all.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: No... it's different this time. Remember what I said back then, that this creation wouldn't be the same as my previous works? But my creations have never varied much before, so why now?

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: While I was writing, I kept wondering where this premonition had come from, and only when I put down my pen did I realize that the change might have already happened, right in front of me.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: In my past journeys, I wrote myself into my stories, becoming a character, and anticipated creating the crystallization of my heart and soul, to act as a guide and inspiration to others.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: But after coming here and seriously observing everyone on Rhodes Island, I've discovered... that my poetry is resonating like never before.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: I think I already am among said heroes, walking alongside them.

steps.name: Erato
steps.text: ...I should write this down.
